newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 25.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China issues rules for local firms raising money outside the country for special projects, requiring total investment for the projects to be at least $30 million each and funds raised to be at least $15 million each.

- Local authorities, exchanges, listed firms and financial institutions say they will strengthen risk control in response to the announcement by the China Securities Regulatory Commission to make 1997 the year for risk control in the securities and futures markets.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai had 59,300 private firms with staff of 628,000 by the end of March.
- Tax income for the city of Shanghai hit a record high of 7.332 billion yuan in the first quarter of this year, an increase of 24.4 percent year-on-year.
